answer: A hostile operator running 43 aliases as a result needs 55 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are published in nectar, expire in summit, and walnut lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 19 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 18 times over for the same share of the pool. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
